verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Workable. Webhook subscriptions (workable-docs-31) are event-triggered notifications, not a recurring schedule. The Workable Agent (workable-docs-15) runs sourcing and screening but with no documented schedule or recurrence. The auto-updating job widget is an adjacent feature, and a user could only approximate scheduling with external cron jobs calling the API, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
